pages.text: $(l)Moonblossom$(/l) is a glowing flower (night vision in suspicious stew). $(l)Glow Fern$(/l), $(l)Glow Algae$(/l) and $(l)Lumen Reeds$(/l) carpet the land and swamps. $(l)Lumen Fruit$(/l) gives brief night vision; $(l)Lumen Nectar$(/l) (bottle a Stillbloom) gives regeneration.
Right-click soil with a Glowberry to plant a bush. Bone-meal it to ripen; right-click a ripe bush to harvest — it regrows.
Glowcap Stew — hearty, with night vision. Returns the bowl.
